1.note: Conversation with uniqueName order-<id>, JSON attributes {orderId, listingId}, two chat participants (created server-side when missing)

2.note: no custom message type: card in message JSON attributes (4 KB); server updates attributes via REST, clients get messageUpdated. Rendering is entirely ours

3.note: no moderation: pre-event onMessageAdd webhook rewrites the body with our regex mask (Twilio's documented modify response); no report API, our queue. Needs an https PUBLIC_URL

4.note: no email: post-event onMessageAdded webhook + Reachability (User.isOnline) -> Mailpit. Web push via FCM is native but not run (no Firebase credentials)

5.note: no translation: our server provider, translations in message attributes; not run without TRANSLATION_PROVIDER

6.note: conversation.add('agent_sam') (falls back to REST participants.create); up to 1000 participants, 50 non-chat. Twist: addPhoneParticipant adds the seller's phone over SMS/WhatsApp (costs money; not run until confirmed)

7.note: read horizon via setAllMessagesRead + participantUpdated(lastReadMessageIndex) (SDK does not set it automatically); typing() signal; media via FormData with 300 s temporary URLs. Chat-side delivery receipts do not exist
